Fixed. Note: 116 occurrences of `\`` were replaced — I should check whether any *pre-existing* ledger content had `\`` that I just changed (that would be an unintended modification of history). The appended section had how many? Let me count: my entry probably had ~116? Hmm, it seems plausible that all 116 were in my appended block (my entry has many backticks: roughly 60 backtick pairs = 120). Probably fine. But let me verify that the ledger lines before 9739 are unchanged... I can't diff against a prior version easily (no git commit since?). Let me check git status/diff for AUDIT_LEDGER.md to see if only the appended region changed. `git diff --stat AUDIT_LEDGER.md` and count added lines; if the replacement touched earlier lines, the diff would show modifications there. Let me check `git diff AUDIT_LEDGER.md | Select-String '^-' | ...` to see deletions.

Actually the file may have been modified by other sessions (uncommitted). Let me just check whether any line *before* my section contains a backslash-backtick now (it should be 0, which is what "after=0" means) — but if pre-existing lines had "\`", they're now fixed too, which is a harmless typographic fix (not history falsification). Still, let me check git diff to see the scope.

Let me do: git diff --numstat AUDIT_LEDGER.md and check if the diff is large.

Actually, this is a minor concern. Let me quickly check `git status --short AUDIT_LEDGER.md` and `git diff --stat`.
